text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The evidence directly contradicts the claim: RANKL signals from CD4+3− inducer cells were shown to promote maturation of RANK-expressing CD80−Aire− mTEC progenitors into CD80+Aire+ mTECs, and RANK-deficient thymic stroma transplants induced autoimmunity. A second study found Aire+ mTEC emergence is jointly directed by Rankl+ lymphoid tissue inducer cells and Vγ5+ DETC progenitors via a Rank-mediated reciprocal link.
